description: C8 conformance suite. Every id must be produced by harness.evaluation.conformance.cases; a missing or undeclared case fails the gate.

cases.invariant: a 429 is retried within the policy and can succeed
a 500 is retried within the policy and can succeed
an expired run deadline refuses a retry
a duplicate effect begin is idempotent and finish records done
the exported trace is run -> step -> tool/LLM with one terminal state
the hook vocabulary is closed and includes the step hooks
the portable tool manifest is versioned, digested and honest
the plugin SDK declares a version
